WITH premiums_by_period AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Effective_Date AS coverage_period_start,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
    FROM policy AS pol
    JOIN policy_amount AS pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = pol.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN premium AS prem
        ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE pol.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date
),
period_changes AS (
    SELECT
        coverage_period_start,
        annual_premium,
        LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY coverage_period_start) AS previous_annual_premium
    FROM premiums_by_period
)
SELECT
    coverage_period_start,
    annual_premium,
    100.0 * (annual_premium - previous_annual_premium)
        / NULLIF(previous_annual_premium, 0) AS premium_percentage_change
FROM period_changes
ORDER BY coverage_period_start;

answer.sql:
WITH bands AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        (1, '0-5 miles', 0, 5),
        (2, '6-10 miles', 6, 10),
        (3, '11-15 miles', 11, 15),
        (4, 'More than 15 miles', 16, NULL)
    ) AS b(sort_order, distance_band, min_miles, max_miles)
)
SELECT
    b.distance_band,
    COUNT(f.Nearest_Firestation_miles) AS claim_count,
    AVG(f.Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM bands AS b
LEFT JOIN fire_claim AS f
    ON f.Nearest_Firestation_miles >= b.min_miles
   AND (b.max_miles IS NULL OR f.Nearest_Firestation_miles <= b.max_miles)
GROUP BY b.sort_order, b.distance_band
ORDER BY b.sort_order;

  - AVG(Loss_Ratio) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(TRIM(Fireplace)) = 'no')
  AS average_loss_ratio_difference
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT corr(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

answer.sql:
WITH period_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Effective_Date AS period_start,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount)::DOUBLE AS annual_premium
    FROM policy AS p
    JOIN policy_amount AS pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN premium AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    GROUP BY pa.Effective_Date
),
ranked_periods AS (
    SELECT
        period_start,
        annual_premium,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_start) AS first_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY period_start DESC) AS last_rank
    FROM period_premiums
),
endpoints AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(period_start) FILTER (WHERE first_rank = 1) AS first_start,
        MAX(annual_premium) FILTER (WHERE first_rank = 1) AS first_premium,
        MAX(period_start) FILTER (WHERE last_rank = 1) AS last_start,
        MAX(annual_premium) FILTER (WHERE last_rank = 1) AS last_premium
    FROM ranked_periods
)
SELECT
    100.0 * (
        POWER(
            last_premium / NULLIF(first_premium, 0),
            365.25 / NULLIF(DATE_DIFF('day', first_start, last_start), 0)
        ) - 1
    ) AS cagr_percent
FROM endpoints;

SELECT
  Number_of_Firefighters,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY average_loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
  date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
  100.0 * date_diff('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
    / NULLIF(date_diff('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date), 0)
    AS percent_time_open
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN occurrences AS o
  ON c.Occurrence_Identifier = o.Occurrence_Identifier;

WITH incurred_losses AS (
  SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total
  FROM claim_amount ca
  JOIN claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
  WHERE c.Claim_Open_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
    AND c.Claim_Open_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
      )
    )
),
earned_premium AS (
  SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total
  FROM premium p
  JOIN policy_amount pa
    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
    ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  WHERE pcd.Effective_Date >= DATE '2019-01-01'
    AND pcd.Effective_Date < DATE '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT incurred_losses.total::DOUBLE / NULLIF(earned_premium.total, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM incurred_losses
CROSS JOIN earned_premium;

WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM loss_payment lp
                WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            ) OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM loss_reserve lr
                WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
            THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
        ) AS total_loss,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM expense_payment ep
                WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            ) OR EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM expense_reserve er
                WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
            )
            THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END
        ) AS total_expense
    FROM claim c
    LEFT JOIN claim_amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe,
    COALESCE(ct.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    100.0 * COALESCE(ct.total_expense, 0)
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(ct.total_loss, 0), 0) AS expense_percentage_of_loss
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat
    ON cat.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_totals ct
    ON ct.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(r.total_reserved, 0) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM claim AS c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT amounts.Claim_Identifier, SUM(amounts.Claim_Amount) AS total_paid
  FROM (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_payment AS lp USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN expense_payment AS ep USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
  ) AS amounts
  GROUP BY amounts.Claim_Identifier
) AS p ON p.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT amounts.Claim_Identifier, SUM(amounts.Claim_Amount) AS total_reserved
  FROM (
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN loss_reserve AS lr USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ca.Claim_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    JOIN expense_reserve AS er USING (Claim_Amount_Identifier)
  ) AS amounts
  GROUP BY amounts.Claim_Identifier
) AS r ON r.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier;

WITH claim_links AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Claim_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        pcd.Effective_Date
    FROM claim_coverage AS cc
    JOIN claim AS c
        ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
       AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
),
claimed_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Policy_Identifier,
        Effective_Date
    FROM claim_links
),
premium_by_period AS (
    SELECT
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        pcd.Effective_Date,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium
    FROM policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
    JOIN policy_amount AS pa
        ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
       AND pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
    JOIN premium AS prem
        ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Policy_Identifier, pcd.Effective_Date
),
incurred_loss_by_period AS (
    SELECT
        cl.Policy_Identifier,
        cl.Effective_Date,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Incurred_Loss
    FROM claim_links AS cl
    JOIN claim_amount AS ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment AS lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve AS lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY cl.Policy_Identifier, cl.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    cp.Effective_Date AS Coverage_Start_Date,
    COALESCE(pb.Premium, 0) AS Premium,
    COALESCE(lb.Incurred_Loss, 0) AS Incurred_Loss,
    COALESCE(lb.Incurred_Loss, 0) / NULLIF(pb.Premium, 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM claimed_periods AS cp
JOIN policy AS p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premium_by_period AS pb
    ON pb.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
   AND pb.Effective_Date = cp.Effective_Date
LEFT JOIN incurred_loss_by_period AS lb
    ON lb.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
   AND lb.Effective_Date = cp.Effective_Date
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, cp.Effective_Date;

WITH agent_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        person.First_Name,
        person.Last_Name,
        policy.Policy_Identifier
    FROM agreement_party_role AS apr
    JOIN party_role AS pr
        ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    JOIN person
        ON person.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
    JOIN policy
        ON policy.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pr.Party_Role_Name)) = 'agent'
),
policy_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Total_Premium
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS prem
        ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_losses AS (
    SELECT
        loss_amounts.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(loss_amounts.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Loss_Paid
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            pcd.Policy_Identifier,
            ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier,
            ca.Claim_Amount
        FROM claim_coverage AS cc
        JOIN policy_coverage_detail AS pcd
            ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
           AND pcd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
        JOIN claim_amount AS ca
            ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
        JOIN loss_payment AS lp
            ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) AS loss_amounts
    GROUP BY loss_amounts.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    ap.First_Name,
    ap.Last_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Policy_Identifier) AS Distinct_Policies_Sold,
    SUM(COALESCE(pp.Total_Premium, 0)) AS Total_Premium,
    SUM(COALESCE(pl.Total_Loss_Paid, 0)) AS Total_Loss_Paid
FROM agent_policies AS ap
LEFT JOIN policy_premiums AS pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_losses AS pl
    ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY ap.First_Name, ap.Last_Name;

WITH claim_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_claim_cost
    FROM claim_amount AS ca
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment AS lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve AS lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM expense_payment AS ep
        WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM expense_reserve AS er
        WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_details AS (
    SELECT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        la.Postal_Code AS zip_code,
        c.Claim_Open_Date,
        c.Claim_Close_Date,
        COALESCE(cc.total_claim_cost, 0) AS total_claim_cost
    FROM claim AS c
    JOIN insurable_object AS io
        ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location AS gl
        ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address AS la
        ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN claim_costs AS cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    zip_code,
    SUM(total_claim_cost) AS total_claim_cost,
    AVG(date_diff('day', Claim_Open_Date, Claim_Close_Date)) AS average_days_open_to_close
FROM claim_details
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY zip_code;

answer.sql:
WITH holder_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.Person_Identifier,
        p.First_Name,
        p.Last_Name,
        pol.Policy_Identifier
    FROM person p
    JOIN party pa
        ON pa.Party_Identifier = p.Person_Identifier
    JOIN agreement_party_role apr
        ON apr.Party_Identifier = pa.Party_Identifier
    JOIN party_role pr
        ON pr.Party_Role_Code = apr.Party_Role_Code
    JOIN policy pol
        ON pol.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(pr.Party_Role_Name)) = 'policy holder'
),
premium_by_period AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium prem
        ON prem.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        pa.Effective_Date
),
coverage_periods AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        hp.Person_Identifier,
        hp.First_Name,
        hp.Last_Name,
        pcd.Policy_Identifier,
        pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        pcd.Effective_Date,
        pcd.Expiration_Date
    FROM holder_policies hp
    JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = hp.Policy_Identifier
),
period_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cp.Person_Identifier,
        cp.First_Name,
        cp.Last_Name,
        cp.Policy_Identifier,
        cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cp.Effective_Date,
        cp.Expiration_Date,
        COALESCE(pbp.Premium, 0) AS Premium
    FROM coverage_periods cp
    LEFT JOIN premium_by_period pbp
        ON pbp.Policy_Identifier = cp.Policy_Identifier
        AND pbp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
        AND pbp.Effective_Date = cp.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
    First_Name,
    Last_Name,
    SUM(Premium) AS Total_Premium,
    COUNT(*) AS Coverage_Period_Count,
    AVG(Premium) AS Average_Premium_Per_Coverage_Period
FROM period_totals
GROUP BY First_Name, Last_Name;

WITH claim_counts AS (
    SELECT
        Catastrophe_Identifier,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims
    FROM claim
    GROUP BY Catastrophe_Identifier
),
loss_paid AS (
    SELECT
        cl.Catastrophe_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_paid
    FROM claim cl
    JOIN claim_amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY cl.Catastrophe_Identifier
),
loss_reserved AS (
    SELECT
        cl.Catastrophe_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_reserved
    FROM claim cl
    JOIN claim_amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cl.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY cl.Catastrophe_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    cc.number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(lp.total_loss_paid, 0) AS total_loss_paid,
    COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserved, 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
    100.0 * COALESCE(lp.total_loss_paid, 0)
        / NULLIF(
            COALESCE(lp.total_loss_paid, 0) + COALESCE(lr.total_loss_reserved, 0),
            0
        ) AS paid_share_of_incurred_loss_percentage
FROM catastrophe cat
JOIN claim_counts cc
    ON cc.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_paid lp
    ON lp.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserved lr
    ON lr.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier;

WITH claim_properties AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Insurable_Object_Identifier
    FROM claim
    WHERE Insurable_Object_Identifier IS NOT NULL
),
incurred_losses AS (
    SELECT
        c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim AS c
    JOIN claim_amount AS ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_payment AS lp
        WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loss_reserve AS lr
        WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    )
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount AS pa
    JOIN premium AS p
        ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        la.Line_1_Address AS street_address,
        CAST(COALESCE(il.incurred_loss, 0) AS DOUBLE)
            / NULLIF(CAST(pp.total_premium AS DOUBLE), 0.0)
            AS incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio
    FROM claim_properties AS cp
    JOIN insurable_object AS io
        ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location AS gl
        ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address AS la
        ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN incurred_losses AS il
        ON il.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN property_premiums AS pp
        ON pp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
    street_address,
    incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio,
    RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS property_rank
FROM property_ratios
ORDER BY property_rank, street_address;
